what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Brazil whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 549534 people in this group, 9.1% of all Venezuelans in it worldwide.
Brazil also counted 149501 Venezuelan refugees that year, the second largest number after Spain.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Brazil start in 2018 at 39771 and reach 549534 in 2025, their highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025; big changes also came between 2018 and 2019 and between 2021 and 2022.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR, and UNHCR adds notes to some of the figures.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in Brazil they live.
